source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 05 New Fuel Plug adapters.pdf
title: Fuel Plug Adapters
lead: MOC has developed 2 new fuel plug adapters for use on various Ford vehicles.
body: These new plug adapters can be used with the 72001 Adapter (3/8") and the 72002 Adapter (1/2").
